metadata.description: XBrain Design: an optional plugin of the XBrain ecosystem with design skills (named styles, patterns and a glossary, the brain's designs, motion, quality, accessibility), agents and starter templates for Claude Code and Claude Desktop.

plugins.name: xbrain-design
plugins.description: Design for your own products and the XBrain brain's designs, from value to code: named styles (canvas-light, studio-cut, ink-play and nine more), about fifty patterns with parameters, a glossary of names, how the ecosystem's sites are built, motion, quality and accessibility.
